title: VisionTrust AI Assurance & Integrity Assessment

executive_summary.explanation: No integrity violations or anomalies detected.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Feature k-NN neighborhood consensus & imbalance analysis
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires distinct feature cluster separation between classes.
Effectiveness depends on presence of source/batch annotations.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Perceptual Hashing (pHash, dHash) Hamming distance clustering
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Sensitivity tuned via threshold; heavily transformed images may escape.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Isolation Forest & statistical feature distribution distances
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: High-dimensional semantic outliers require reference baseline.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Localized patch spatial consistency & class correlation search
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Blended or frequency-domain watermarks require gradient-based attribution.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Cryptographic SHA-256 identity & parameter count verification
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires trusted reference fingerprint for comparison.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Tensor statistics, layer shapes, and mean L2-norm fingerprinting
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: External weights or opaque black-box runtimes degrade capability.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Controlled perturbation battery (brightness, noise, patch collapse)
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Cannot prove absence of dormant triggers without trigger inversion.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Cryptographic hash binding + Ed25519 digital signatures
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Protects recorded inferences; requires secure local key storage.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Cryptographic nonces, monotonic sequence checks, timestamp skews
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires database persistence of past nonce records.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: Canonical JSON serialization hashing for preprocessing & runtime config
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Config schema changes must remain backward-compatible.

coverage_matrix.primary_method: PSI, 2-sample KS test, Wasserstein distance, environmental categorization
coverage_matrix.key_limitation: Requires sufficient sample volume (N >= 20) for statistical significance.

system_limitations: Framework runs 100% locally and does not transmit data or consult cloud foundation models.
Statistical heuristics cannot mathematically prove total absence of steganographic or adversarial latent triggers.
Model weight analysis on ONNX models depends on initializers embedded within the graph file.
Offline cryptographic protection guarantees tamper-evident provenance but assumes private key is stored securely in air-gapped host.
